RustyShelf 0.6.1 fixes two things in Trophies and manuals, and tidies the app's insides.

## Fixed

- **Trophies' pictures** come in when you switch Show (Games, Recent unlocks, Mastered) with ← →. Before, the new rows' pictures stayed blank.
- **Wrong manual** says so if setting a manual aside stops half way, instead of staying on "Looking for another manual…".

## Changed

- The jobs that run in the background, the ones that run a few at a time and the Settings rows you change with ← → now share one way of working each. Nothing should look different; if something does, please [open an issue](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues).

## Download

| | File | |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `RustyShelf-0.6.1-windows-setup.exe` | The installer. |
| | `RustyShelf-0.6.1-windows.zip` | The app and its `data` folder, to unzip anywhere. `--windowed` starts it in a window. |
| **Linux** | `RustyShelf-0.6.1-linux.AppImage` | `chmod +x` it once, then start it. |
| **Android** | `RustyShelf-0.6.1-android.apk` | arm64. Installs over 0.6.0. |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` has each file's SHA-256 sum.

The manual lists [everything that works](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/blob/rustyshelf/docs/MANUAL.md#what-works).
